business_summary.text: Ice Make Refrigeration Limited is an established provider of industrial and commercial refrigeration and cold-chain solutions, with offerings across cold rooms, commercial and industrial refrigeration, transport refrigeration, ammonia systems, PUF panels, cold storage infrastructure, and allied Solutions.

operating_notes.text: New verticals (chest freezers and continuous panels) contributed 35-36% to Q1FY27 revenue
Capacity utilization in new verticals is 60% in Q1FY27, slightly less in Q2 due to seasonal impact
Addressable market size for Galilei JV products estimated at ₹1200-1500 Cr

timeline.summary: Ice Make Refrigeration Limited conducted Q1FY27 earnings call on August 18, 2026, reporting 60% YoY revenue growth to ₹178.88 Cr but margin pressure at 1.7% EBITDA margin, with FY27 guidance reduced to 6-6.5% and proposed ₹180 Cr investment from Galilei Holdings for a JV.
